column1: Purpose: Take your funnel metrics and work backward from your lifetime revenue goal, so you know exactly how many clients, shows, booked calls, applications, outbound clicks, and dollars of ad spend it takes to get there.
1. Enter your Lifetime Revenue Goal and Customer Lifetime Revenue in both the Actual and Goal columns.
2. Enter your current funnel metrics in the Actual column: Close Rate, Show Rate, Call-Booked Rate, Application Rate, and Cost Per Outbound Click.
3. Enter the Goal version of each funnel metric in the Goal column. This is what you're working toward.
4. Everything below fills in on its own, working backward from your goal to the clients, calls, clicks, and ad spend required to hit it.
5. The % Difference column shows how far your Actual numbers are from your Goal numbers. Use it to see where the biggest gaps are.
